qs.q:
Match the messages (1–5) and suggestions/statements (A–F).
There is one letter you do not need.

0. When you come to London, there's no need for you to book into a hotel. You can sleep at my place. [G = Stay with me.]
1. It's a government building and the guard will surely ask for some proof of who you are before he lets you in.
2. You'd love this place. I'm so sorry you couldn't take a few days off and join us.
3. The castle is not far from our hotel. We can walk there. All you need are comfortable shoes.
4. All the expenses are covered, but we should either take some sandwiches or have lunch in a local pub.
5. Let's go shopping this weekend. We can get some designer clothes at bargain prices.
items: 1 — Government building. Guard will ask for proof of who you are.
2 — You'd love this place. I'm so sorry you couldn't join us.
3 — The castle is not far. We can walk there. Just comfortable shoes.
4 — All expenses covered, but food is not included.
5 — Let's go shopping. Designer clothes at bargain prices.
rights: B — You need to take your ID.
C — Food is not included in the price.
D — We can go there on foot.

"I presented my science project today. I was excited about it, because I wanted to show the class what I had done. Unfortunately, I had left half of my drawings and photos at home. So it was very boring for my classmates. And I had such great expectations."

Why did Sam join the fitness club?

"I've joined a fitness club! There are lots of people there trying to lose weight. But there are some who just want to keep in good condition, like me. Fortunately, it's a good atmosphere there, and I'm making new friends."

A To meet new people.
B To lose weight.
C To stay fit.

What do Lexi's parents have a problem with?

"I've got a tattoo on my shoulder now! My parents won't like that. There's a lot they don't like. They don't like loud music, so I use earphones when they're home. They don't like my boyfriend – they say I'm crazy to be with him."

A Her tattoo.
B Her music.
C Her boyfriend.

"Thanks for the CD. Great music. I'll bring it to school tomorrow. Can you lend me the DVD you told me about? I'd like to see it. And can you bring me back my maths book? I need it to prepare for a test."

A A book.
